title: Planned maintenance: NBN services in Aspley and Petrie (QLD) POI areas
current_summary: The planned cable network cutover affecting NBN services connected through the Aspley and Petrie points of interconnect in Queensland has been completed. The maintenance window ran from 11:00 PM on 19 November 2026 to 6:00 AM on 20 November 2026 (Queensland time). If you are still experiencing problems with your service, please restart your modem and contact our support team if the issue continues.

cause.reason: Planned cable network cutover by a network provider

updates.content: We have been advised that a network provider will be carrying out a cable network cutover that may affect NBN services connected through the Aspley and Petrie points of interconnect in Queensland. The work is scheduled between 11:00 PM on 19 November 2026 and 6:00 AM on 20 November 2026 (Queensland time). During this window, some NBN services may be interrupted for up to 6 hours. We will share more information if anything changes.

The planned cable network cutover work started at 11:00 PM (Queensland time) on 19 November 2026. Some NBN services connected through the Aspley and Petrie points of interconnect may be interrupted for up to 6 hours during the window, which is scheduled to end at 6:00 AM on 20 November 2026. We will update you if the timing changes.

The planned cable network cutover affecting NBN services connected through the Aspley and Petrie points of interconnect in Queensland is now complete. The maintenance window closed at 6:00 AM on 20 November 2026 (Queensland time). Services should be operating normally. If you still have problems, please restart your modem and contact our support team if the issue continues.
